lombalgie.title: Chronic Low Back Pain
lombalgie.desc:
Persistent lower back pain, with or without radiating pain in the leg (sciatica or cruralgia), can be related to osteoarthritis, a herniated disc, narrowing of the lumbar canal (spinal stenosis), or other spinal conditions.

Depending on the identified cause, several interventional techniques may be proposed, including image-guided spinal injections, diagnostic blocks, or targeted treatments of the pain-generating structures.

A specialized evaluation will determine the most suitable solutions to improve your daily comfort and mobility.

nevralgie_arnold.title: Occipital Neuralgia
nevralgie_arnold.desc:
Occipital neuralgia manifests as pain localized at the back of the skull, the nape of the neck, and sometimes the scalp. This pain can be triggered or aggravated by certain neck movements.

When conventional treatments are insufficient, interventional solutions such as targeted injections or cryoneurolysis can be proposed.

The goal is to durably reduce pain and improve the quality of life for patients suffering from this often debilitating condition.

sdrc.title: Complex Regional Pain Syndrome (CRPS)

endometriose.title: Endometriosis and Chronic Pelvic Pain
endometriose.desc:
Chronic pelvic pain associated with endometriosis can have a major impact on daily, professional, and family life.

ITID works collaboratively with gynecologists and specialized teams to offer comprehensive care.

Depending on each situation, targeted interventional treatments can help decrease pain intensity, improve comfort, and reduce reliance on pharmacological treatments.

douleurs_articulaires.title: Joint Pain (Shoulder, Hip, Knee...)

fibromyalgie.title: Fibromyalgia
fibromyalgie.desc:
Fibromyalgia is a condition characterized by widespread and persistent pain associated with significant fatigue, sleep disturbances, concentration difficulties, and sometimes sensory hypersensitivity.

Management relies on a multidisciplinary approach that may combine pharmacological treatments, adapted physical activity, mind-body support, and, in certain situations, specific techniques such as analgesic infusions.

Each therapeutic plan is individualized to address the specific needs of the patient.

douleurs_neuropathiques.title: Neuropathic Pain

douleurs_post_op.title: Chronic Post-operative and Post-traumatic Pain
douleurs_post_op.desc:
Some pain persists for months after surgery or trauma despite tissue healing.

These pains can have inflammatory, neurological, or mechanical components requiring specific management.

After a thorough assessment, several therapeutic options can be considered: targeted injections, cryoneurolysis, radiofrequency, or other interventional treatments tailored to the clinical situation.

migraine.title: Refractory Headaches and Migraines
migraine.desc:
Chronic headaches and migraines resistant to usual treatments can significantly impair quality of life.

A specialized consultation helps identify trigger factors, evaluate underlying mechanisms, and establish a personalized therapeutic strategy.

Certain targeted injections or interventional techniques may be offered to selected patients to reduce the frequency and intensity of attacks.

treatments.title: Treatments
treatments.subtitle: Discover in detail the image-guided interventional techniques offered by ITID. Minimally invasive solutions for your relief.

t01.title: Spinal and Epidural Injections

t02.title: Injections for Joint Pain
t02.desc:
Joint injections are a recognized therapeutic option for certain shoulder, knee, hip, or other joint pains.

They can reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and promote functional recovery when standard treatments prove insufficient.

t03.title: Lidocaine Infusions
t03.desc:
Lidocaine infusion is used in certain chronic pains, particularly neuropathic ones, when conventional drug treatments do not provide satisfactory relief.

Performed under medical supervision, this approach can lead to a significant decrease in pain intensity in some patients.

t04.title: Dorsal Root Ganglion Stimulation
t04.desc:
An advanced neuromodulation technique, dorsal root ganglion stimulation acts on nervous structures involved in pain transmission.

It is particularly studied in certain severe neuropathic pains and in Complex Regional Pain Syndrome (CRPS).

t05.title: Cryoneurolysis
t05.desc:
Cryoneurolysis involves applying controlled cold to a nerve identified as responsible for the pain.

This minimally invasive technique aims to temporarily interrupt the transmission of pain signals while preserving surrounding structures.

It can be proposed for certain localized chronic pains or spasticity.

t06.title: rTMS
t06.desc:
rTMS uses non-invasive magnetic pulses applied to the brain to modulate certain circuits involved in pain perception.

This innovative technique can be offered for certain chronic pains resistant to conventional treatments.

t07.title: Peripheral Nerve Blocks
t07.desc:
Peripheral nerve blocks allow the injection of a local anesthetic near a nerve or a group of nerves.

They can be used for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes to identify the origin of certain pains and sometimes provide immediate relief.

t08.title: Radiofrequency
t08.desc:
Radiofrequency is a technique that uses controlled thermal energy to act on nerve fibers responsible for certain chronic pains.

It is frequently used in spinal, joint, or nerve-related pain.

t09.title: Botulinum Toxin
t09.desc:
Botulinum toxin can be used in certain muscular, neuropathic, or spasticity-related pains.

Its administration is performed after precise medical evaluation to identify patients likely to benefit most from it.

t10.title: TENS
t10.desc:
TENS is a portable device that delivers weak electrical impulses through the skin.

This non-invasive technique can help reduce certain chronic pains and is often a useful adjunct in comprehensive pain management.

t11.title: Perineural Catheter
t11.desc:
A perineural catheter allows the continuous administration of a local anesthetic near a nerve over several hours or days.

It is particularly useful in certain complex post-operative or severe post-traumatic pains.

t12.title: Capsaicin Patch (Qutenza®)
t12.desc:
The high-concentration capsaicin patch is intended for the treatment of certain localized neuropathic pains.

Its application is performed at the medical office in a safe environment under specialized supervision.

The treatment can provide prolonged relief for several weeks or months in some patients.

t13.title: Virtual Reality Hypnosis (HypnoVR)
t13.desc:
HypnoVR combines the benefits of medical hypnosis with immersive virtual reality technologies.

This innovative approach helps reduce anxiety, improve patient comfort, and assist in managing certain chronic pains or procedure-related anxiety.

t14.title: Spinal Cord Stimulation
t14.desc:
Spinal cord stimulation is a neuromodulation technique consisting of delivering controlled electrical impulses to the spinal cord.

It is reserved for certain severe chronic pains resistant to conventional treatments.

After an evaluation phase, it can lead to a significant reduction in pain and an improvement in quality of life.

nouvelle-approche-neuromodulation.title: Spinal Cord Stimulation: A Silent Revolution
nouvelle-approche-neuromodulation.summary: Discover how next-generation implants are transforming the daily lives of patients suffering from refractory neuropathic pain.

sections.s1: Spinal cord stimulation is a surgical technique involving the implantation of electrodes in the spinal cord. These electrodes deliver weak electrical impulses that block or modify the pain signal before it reaches the brain.
sections.s2: Today, new generators adjust stimulation in real-time based on the patient's position. This is a major breakthrough.
sections.s5: At ITID, we offer a comprehensive multidisciplinary evaluation before considering this solution, ensuring an optimal success rate for our patients.

hypnose-gestion-douleur.title: Medical Hypnosis: Regaining Control Over Your Pain
hypnose-gestion-douleur.summary: Often viewed with skepticism, medical hypnosis is now a formidable and scientifically validated therapeutic weapon against chronic pain.

sections.s1: Medical hypnosis has nothing to do with stage hypnosis. It is a natural modified state of consciousness that we all experience (for example, when we are absorbed in a book or a movie).
sections.s2: In the context of chronic pain, hypnosis alters the brain's perception of the pain signal, thereby decreasing its intensity and emotional impact.
sections.s4_1: Decrease in anxiety related to anticipatory pain

alimentation-anti-inflammatoire.title: Nutrition and Pain: The Anti-inflammatory Plate
alimentation-anti-inflammatoire.summary: What we eat directly affects our body's level of inflammation. A practical guide to foods to prioritize for pain relief.

sections.s0: The link between gut and inflammation
sections.s1: Our gut microbiota plays a key role in regulating our immune system. An imbalanced intestinal flora (dysbiosis) can promote low-grade systemic inflammation, exacerbating existing chronic pain.
sections.s2: The pillars of the anti-inflammatory diet
sections.s3_0: Omega-3 (small fatty fish, walnut oil, flax seeds)
sections.s3_1: Antioxidants (red fruits, colorful vegetables, spices like turmeric)
sections.s3_2: Reduction of refined sugars and ultra-processed foods
sections.s4: Diet does not replace medical treatment, but it is the ground on which healing can take root.

inauguration-nouveau-plateau.title: Inauguration of our new 4.0 technical platform
inauguration-nouveau-plateau.summary: ITID is expanding with a brand new block dedicated to percutaneous interventions under state-of-the-art ultrasound guidance and fluoroscopy.

sections.s0: We are proud to announce the official opening of our new technical platform, designed entirely for the comfort and safety of our patients.
sections.s1: This 250sqm space incorporates latest-generation ultrasound machines with artificial intelligence, allowing for infiltrations and nerve blocks with unprecedented millimeter precision.
sections.s3: Designed with the principles of curative architecture, the new block diffuses therapeutic light, optimal acoustic insulation, and offers a virtual reality headset for perioperative relaxation.

tens-mode-d-emploi.title: TENS Neurostimulation: How to use it properly at home?
tens-mode-d-emploi.summary: TENS is a fantastic device, provided you know how to use it. Here are common mistakes to avoid and optimal settings.

sections.s1: TENS (Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation) uses a weak electrical current to stimulate nerves via electrodes placed on the skin. By stimulating tactile fibers (large fibers), it "closes the gate" to the pain signal (small fibers).
sections.s3: The golden rule: surround the painful area. Electrodes must never touch each other and must be placed on clean, dry, unbroken skin.
sections.s4_0: Do not place on the front of the neck (carotids)
sections.s4_1: Do not use with a pacemaker (unless strict cardiology advice)
sections.s4_2: Change electrodes as soon as they no longer stick well to avoid burns

realite-virtuelle-analgesie.title: Virtual Reality Analgesia: The Future is Here
realite-virtuelle-analgesie.summary: How immersion in computer-generated soothing universes manages to decrease the pain felt during our care.

sections.s0: Pain is largely a cerebral experience. By saturating the brain's attention capabilities with an immersive visual and auditory environment, virtual reality acts as a powerful analgesic.
sections.s2: We use therapeutic virtual reality headsets during potentially anxiety-provoking procedures (infiltrations, IV placement, radiofrequency). Patients choose their universe (beach, mountain, seabed).
sections.s3: It's impressive: some patients under virtual reality have a heart rate that decreases during care, instead of increasing.
